description: nf-core/riboseq samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 1.2.0 schema. Ribosome profiling (Ribo-seq).

aligner.help: only star is supported at this revision

pipeline.name: nf-core/riboseq
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, strandedness, type. strandedness and type are REQUIRED and enum-constrained.

validation_rules: The file consumed by the pipeline must be comma-separated (CSV).
strandedness must be one of: forward, reverse, unstranded, auto.
type must be one of: riboseq, rnaseq, tiseq — and must reflect the real assay, not a default.
A cohort containing only rnaseq-type rows is an ordinary RNA-seq experiment: use nf-core/rnaseq instead.
notes: Ribosome profiling. star_index and salmon_index are built from FASTA+GTF when absent; the Luria refs tree has no prebuilt indices, so expect a build on first run per genome.

sources.label: nf-core/riboseq nextflow_schema.json @ 1.2.0
sources.notes: Authoritative param names, types and defaults for the pinned revision.

sources.label: nf-core/riboseq assets/schema_input.json @ 1.2.0
sources.notes: Authoritative required/optional samplesheet columns and allowed values.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/riboseq input samplesheet.

sample.description: Custom sample name; repeat across lanes of one library.
sample.validation_hints: Prefer the NExtSEEK D.SEQ UID so results map back to the sample record.

fastq_1.validation_hints: Absolute Luria path, taken from the sample's Link_PrimaryData / File_PrimaryData.

fastq_2.validation_hints: Blank for single-end; keep the header.

type.description: Which assay this library is. A Ribo-seq experiment normally pairs riboseq libraries with matched rnaseq libraries.
type.validation_hints: Do NOT guess: mislabelling an RNA-seq library as riboseq silently corrupts the analysis. If the assay metadata does not say, ask.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/riboseq samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK D.SEQ cohort.
population_priority: One row per D.SEQ leaf; sample = the UID.
Derive `type` from the sample's assay metadata — riboseq vs matched rnaseq. Never default it.
Set strandedness to auto unless the library metadata states otherwise.
final_checks: Every row has a `type` justified by assay metadata, not assumed.
strandedness uses only the allowed values.
